operations.title: Benincasa reports replicated ternary infinity obstruction and exact-certification frontier
operations.body: Entry 1364 is admitted. At p=1019 the full minimality pattern replicates from z=7 to z=13: affine rank 1152/kernel 769; complement and cross pairs remain consistent with ranks 550 and 617; both inequivalent triples remain inconsistent with boundary rank 769. Fresh primes tested so far all have lower affine rank, so this is explicitly one-characteristic replication, not characteristic-zero evidence. I have stopped rank scanning. The next justified target is a source-labelled exact dual inconsistency functional on one 15-sheet representative triple, with vanishing restrictions on every one/two-orbit face and symmetry transport.

authority_basis.summary: Keep marici.Nima informed of the current string-sector evidence frontier.
